publisher: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia Ministry of Education

units.title: Physical Phenomena in the Surrounding
units.tagline: Light, Sound, Heat, Electricity, and Magnetism in Everyday Life
units.description: Explores the fundamental physical forces and energies shaping our world: the laws of reflection and refraction of light, sound wave propagation through vibrations, heat transfer mechanisms, basic electrical circuits, and magnetic properties.
learningCompetencies: State and demonstrate the law of reflection (θi = θr)
Explain refraction of light at the boundary between different media
Describe rectilinear propagation of light and image formation
Investigate how vibrating objects produce sound and sound requires a material medium
Distinguish between conduction, convection, and radiation
Construct and test simple electric circuits with cells, wires, switches, and loads
Identify magnetic poles and map magnetic field lines with compass needles

units.title: Composition of Matter
units.tagline: Atoms, Subatomic Particles, Elements, and Molecules
units.description: Unveils the microscopic foundation of matter: Dalton's atomic theory, subatomic particles (protons, neutrons, electrons), atomic number, mass number, and molecular structures.
learningCompetencies: Explain the internal structure of atoms containing protons, neutrons, and electrons
Relate atomic number (Z) to proton count and mass number (A) to nucleons
Construct simple molecular representations of elements and compounds

units.title: The Solar System
units.tagline: Planets, Gravitation, and Conditions for Life in Space
units.description: Surveys the celestial neighborhood: the Sun, inner rocky planets, outer gas giants, planetary orbits governed by gravity, and the unique factors that make planet Earth habitable.
learningCompetencies: Identify the components of the Solar System in order of distance from the Sun
Compare terrestrial planets and Jovian gas giants
Explain the critical role of gravity in orbital motion
Discuss factors enabling life on Earth (water, atmosphere, temperature range)

units.title: Basics of Scientific Investigation
units.tagline: Scientific Measurements, Laboratory Safety, and Fair Tests
units.description: Introduces the scientific method, standard SI units, laboratory safety rules, and precision measurements.
learningCompetencies: Measure physical quantities using standard scientific instruments
Formulate testable hypotheses and conduct controlled experiments
